navagio-beach.access: Boat only (Porto Vromi, Volimes, Zakynthos town). Swimming/landing rules have changed several times since 2018; check before booking.
navagio-beach.parking: Free lot at the clifftop viewpoint
navagio-beach.food: Cheap food stalls at the viewpoint lot (gyros etc.)
navagio-beach.note: Access rules (time limits, no swimming zones) changed in 2023; verify with port authority.

elafonissi-beach.access: Drive to lot, 5-10 min walk to sand
elafonissi-beach.sunbeds: Paid. Reported EUR 14-20 for 2 beds + umbrella (varies by source)
elafonissi-beach.food: Taverna near the parking lot, busy at lunch
elafonissi-beach.note: Sunbeds free up after ~14:00. Umbrellas sold at shops near the lot.

myrtos-beach.access: Steep road down, then pebble beach
myrtos-beach.parking: Free, large lot; fills in Jul-Aug (arrive before ~10:30)
myrtos-beach.sunbeds: Paid rental in organised section (price not found); some reports of free umbrellas
myrtos-beach.food: Canteen / small beach bar (usually from mid-June); delivery to umbrellas reported

balos-lagoon.access: Dirt road + walk from car park, or boat from Kissamos

sarakiniko.access: Short walk from car park; rocky, slippery
sarakiniko.sunbeds: None on the beach; deckchairs at nearby bar (price not confirmed)
sarakiniko.food: Food truck sometimes by the car park; not reliable
sarakiniko.note: Little shade; rock too hard for umbrellas. Bring water.

porto-katsiki.parking: Paid, about EUR 10/day car, EUR 3 motorbike (one review: EUR 5)
porto-katsiki.camper: Camper parking listed on campercontact.com (details not checked)
porto-katsiki.sunbeds: Limited; mostly reserved, price not found. Bring own
porto-katsiki.food: Canteens by the car park; restaurant above the beach delivers

voidokilia-beach.access: Dirt parking behind dunes, short walk
voidokilia-beach.food: No bar on beach; one source mentions a bar that delivers. Nearest food in Pylos
voidokilia-beach.note: Natura 2000 area beside Gialova Lagoon; bring all supplies.

egremni-beach.access: About 400 steps from top lot; sources conflict on whether the stairs are open
egremni-beach.food: Small restaurant and shop at top of stairs; cafe and toilets are up the steps

simos-beach.parking: Free, one large lot (full later in day)
simos-beach.camper: Simos Camping on site, about EUR 25-29/night (listing)
simos-beach.sunbeds: Paid, reported EUR 20-50 per set depending on type and year
simos-beach.food: Beach bars on site (names not confirmed)
simos-beach.note: Sunbed price varies widely by report. No shade without rental.

spiaggia-grande.access: Stairs from town (Via dei Mulini), SITA bus, or ferry to the pier
spiaggia-grande.parking: Hard to find; paid in town, from about EUR 10/hour with a 3-hour minimum (one review). Driving not advised
spiaggia-grande.sunbeds: Paid at private clubs: roughly EUR 20-35 pp budget, about EUR 30-50 per bed in reviews, premium clubs EUR 200+. Small free public section at the west end
spiaggia-grande.food: Restaurants and bars along Via Marina Grande and the promenade; some clubs serve food on the sand (e.g. Bruno, La Cambusa)
spiaggia-grande.note: Book clubs early in summer. Prices are indicative (blogs/reviews, some from 2024).

cala-goloritze.access: 3.5 km hike from Golgo plateau; booking required in season (cap 250/day)
cala-goloritze.parking: Su Porteddu hiker lot; ticket reportedly includes parking (one review: free lot, fills in August)
cala-goloritze.food: None on the beach. Bar at the trailhead is the last stop
cala-goloritze.note: Ticket EUR 7 pp via Heart of Sardinia app/site, bookable ~72 h ahead. Off-season no booking but fee at trailhead. Bring 2 L water.

la-pelosa.access: Walk from lot. Daily cap (1,500 in 2025 season 15 May-15 Oct), booking on official site
la-pelosa.parking: Paid, about EUR 2-3/hour, charged 08:00-20:00 (reports differ); fills by midday
la-pelosa.camper: Camper area listed on campercontact.com ('Area La Pelosa'); details not checked
la-pelosa.sunbeds: None on La Pelosa; neighbouring Gabbiano and La Pelosetta have rentable sunbeds. A beach mat is required
la-pelosa.toilets: Toilets/showers included in ticket (extra coin charge reported)
la-pelosa.note: 2025 ticket EUR 3.50 pp/day, under 12 free. 2026 rules not confirmed.

cala-mariolu.access: Boat (Cala Gonone, Santa Maria Navarrese, Arbatax; 40-60 min) or hard hike from Golgo (about 3 h)
cala-mariolu.parking: Free parking reported at Santa Maria Navarrese marina/town; Golgo trailhead not confirmed
cala-mariolu.note: Pebble beach, no natural shade. Busy Jul-Aug; go early or late.

scala-dei-turchi.parking: Day lot on SP68, EUR 6/day (Apr-Oct, 6 places, one listing); other lots nearby
scala-dei-turchi.camper: Paid camper area right at the entrance: about EUR 15-35/night depending on season, 27 spaces, 4 m height limit; services, showers, bar-restaurant, 220V
scala-dei-turchi.food: Bar-restaurant at camper area; restaurants and pizzerias nearby
scala-dei-turchi.toilets: Toilets and showers at the camper area
scala-dei-turchi.note: Camper area runs a tuk-tuk to beaches/lidos on request (cost not confirmed).

spiaggia-dei-conigli.access: Short path from road, or boat. Limited access

cala-violina.access: About 15-min walk from car park, or foot/bike/horse paths
cala-violina.parking: Paid; EUR 10 car + EUR 1 pp reported, booking online (limited places)
cala-violina.food: Small bar on the beach reported, plus a bar at the car park (drinks, pizza, sandwiches); one review says no food on beach
cala-violina.note: Reviews and fee are dated; check booking page. No shuttle found.

cala-luna.access: Boat from Cala Gonone (about 30 min, EUR 20-35 return) or demanding 3-5 h hike
cala-luna.sunbeds: Reported: sunbeds/umbrellas for rent near beach (sources differ); kayak/umbrella stand
cala-luna.food: Bar serving food and drinks on the beach
cala-luna.note: Boat extras: EUR 2 ecological + EUR 2 landing tax, cash.

cala-brandinchi.access: Walk from lot. Protected beach: booking mandatory in peak season (cap 1,500/day)

praia-da-marinha.access: Staircases down the cliff; no step-free access
praia-da-marinha.parking: Free cliff-top lot (about 32 spaces, paved); fills soon after sunrise, then police close the access road ~1 km out. Taxi/Uber may still reach the lot
praia-da-marinha.sunbeds: Not available (sources conflict; bring own shade)
praia-da-marinha.food: Snack bar on the beach (cash only reported); vans and stalls at cliff top
praia-da-marinha.toilets: Toilets at cliff-top lot; no showers
praia-da-marinha.note: Go at sunrise or late afternoon.

benagil-cove.access: Beach in village; cave only by kayak/SUP (about EUR 30/h) or boat
benagil-cove.parking: Scarce; firefighters' lot at top of hill about EUR 3 (tour operator listing)
benagil-cove.sunbeds: No sunbed rental; bring own parasol
benagil-cove.food: Snack shop on the beach; village restaurants close by
benagil-cove.note: Motorboat trips EUR 20-35 cruise past without landing. Summer boat slots sell out days ahead.

praia-dona-ana.parking: Paid parking nearby about EUR 2-4 for a few hours (~60 spaces), fills in summer; free farther away
praia-dona-ana.sunbeds: Paid: about EUR 10 per pair + parasol half day (2024 guide); EUR 20 full day reported. Limited
praia-dona-ana.food: Beach bar concession (beer, snacks). Better meals up in Lagos

praia-da-falesia.access: Long beach with several clifftop access points; stairs down to the sand
praia-da-falesia.parking: Clifftop car parks, reported free but limited; they fill by afternoon in peak season
praia-da-falesia.sunbeds: Sunbed hire at the main access points
praia-da-falesia.food: Restaurants and beach bars along the beach
praia-da-falesia.toilets: Toilets reported along the beach; some sources say paid
praia-da-falesia.lifeguard: Supervised sections only (e.g. Olhos de Agua, Acoteias); season reported as roughly June-September
praia-da-falesia.note: Reported Blue Flag beach. Confirm lifeguard dates and current facilities locally.

praia-do-camilo.access: About 200 wooden steps; not for limited mobility
praia-do-camilo.parking: Small cliff-top lot, limited; some say free early morning. Chaos by ~10:00 in summer
praia-do-camilo.food: Snack bar at bottom of stairs (one review); cafe O Camilo at the top
praia-do-camilo.note: Open status of the beach bar varies by season.

praia-de-odeceixe.parking: Described as straightforward; fee not found
praia-de-odeceixe.camper: Day parking 08:00-20:00 reported, overnight stays prohibited; motorhomes reported barred from the village (signs before the bridge); municipal camper area 3 km away with free services
praia-de-odeceixe.sunbeds: Sunbeds mentioned in one guide (price not found); kayak, SUP, surfboard rentals
praia-de-odeceixe.food: Four commercial establishments on beach, from cafe to restaurant
praia-de-odeceixe.note: Camper rules conflict; confirm with Camara de Aljezur.

praia-da-ursa.access: About 2.6 km round trip from Cabo da Roca; last 400 m steep cliff descent, no stairs
praia-da-ursa.parking: Small lot on the cliff reached by dirt road off the Cabo da Roca road
praia-da-ursa.note: Not advised in rain or wind. Bring water and food.

praia-do-carvalho.access: Tunnel cut in the rock, steep uneven steps; not suitable for wheelchairs
praia-do-carvalho.parking: Cliff-top near tunnel entrance (details not found)
praia-do-carvalho.food: Sources conflict: no facilities vs. a small cliff bar; bring own food and drink
praia-do-carvalho.note: Part of the sand is in a landslide-risk zone (limited-use beach).

praia-da-adraga.access: Road to small cliff-side valley beach
praia-da-adraga.parking: Small lot (~50 cars), about EUR 3/day reported; overflow up the valley. Restaurant parking free if early
praia-da-adraga.food: Adraga restaurant on the beach (seafood; book ahead for dinner); Bar do Fundo nearby
praia-da-adraga.note: Strong surf and currents. No public transport.

es-trenc.access: Several access points; 1.5 km walk from Sa Barralina lot; shuttle has run

cala-macarelleta.access: Reached on foot from Cala Macarella next door; summer bus-only from Ciutadella (June-Sept, about EUR 8.40 return, in 2023; check current)
cala-macarelleta.parking: Sources conflict: one paid and one free lot, free lot with campers overnight; car access banned May-Sept in some years
cala-macarelleta.food: No restaurant at Macarelleta. Susy's Chiringuito on Macarella (meat, fish, salads)
cala-macarelleta.note: Rules are 2018-2024 data; confirm with Consell de Menorca.

ses-illetes.access: Inside Ses Salines natural park; scooter/bike/car
ses-illetes.parking: Parking near La Savina; park access toll EUR 5 reported by one Aug 2025 visitor (unit unclear)
ses-illetes.food: Very expensive per reviews: Juan y Andrea restaurant; EUR 7 water, EUR 50 pasta, EUR 27 sandwich reported at beach bars
ses-illetes.note: Scooter rental about EUR 15-20/day low season, EUR 30-45 high. Taxi back to Pujols about EUR 18.

as-catedrais.access: Staircase; tide-dependent; free permit needed Easter week and 1 Jul-30 Sep (book on Xunta site)
as-catedrais.parking: Two large free lots (paved + gravel); hard to find a space in summer
as-catedrais.note: Visit around low tide (arrive about 2 h before). Dogs restricted Easter and 15 May-15 Sep.

cala-mondrago.access: 10 min walk from lot (Mallorca natural park)
cala-mondrago.parking: Paid, about EUR 5-6 per car, reduced after 17:00 (EUR 3); about 300 spaces, many shaded
cala-mondrago.sunbeds: Limited sunbeds and parasols, price not found
cala-mondrago.food: Beach bar with drinks and light food (lease uncertain as of 2018)
cala-mondrago.note: Pay parking in cash. Bar status may have changed since 2018.

cala-varques.access: 15-60 min walk; stony path, sturdy shoes
cala-varques.parking: No official lot. Old Ma-4014 section closed with bollards (Mar 2026); roadside parking prohibited, fines reported
cala-varques.food: None (makeshift bar mentioned once); bring water
cala-varques.note: Manacor council limiting access amid congestion (Mar 2026). Check before driving.

cala-de-la-granadella.access: Shuttle/train from upper lot or walk
cala-de-la-granadella.parking: Guardia Park lot about 200 spaces, barriers in Jul-Aug; fee not confirmed. Shuttle about EUR 5 pp (11:00-20:00, not running in 2022)
cala-de-la-granadella.sunbeds: Rented via concession (low cost; price not found); hammocks too
cala-de-la-granadella.food: Three restaurants at the cove per Javea tourism (names not confirmed)
cala-de-la-granadella.note: Pebble beach: bring water shoes. Arrive before 10:00 peak season.

praia-de-rodas.access: Ferry from Vigo (40-50 min), Cangas or Baiona; free Xunta permit (cap 2,200/day) obtained before ferry ticket
praia-de-rodas.camper: Camping only: official Cies campsite near Rodas; reservations open 1 March; overnight allowed Easter week and 15 May-15 Sep
praia-de-rodas.food: Restaurant next to the pier on Rodas; on-site restaurant at campsite
praia-de-rodas.note: Ferry ticket needs permit code. Exchange digital ticket for paper before boarding.

cala-pregonda.access: 20-35 min walk from Binimel-la lot, no shade
cala-pregonda.parking: Free lot at Binimel-la (150+ spaces), fills before ~10:00
cala-pregonda.food: No bar on beach; a bar/restaurant at end of car park
cala-pregonda.toilets: None on beach; nearest at Binimel-la
cala-pregonda.note: Parking is free per older sources; not re-checked.

zlatni-rat.access: Free beach access; 20-25 min walk from Bol town through pine woods, or taxi
zlatni-rat.parking: Paid; EUR 10-25/day depending on source (2026 reviews EUR 10-20). Cheaper lots a few hundred metres away
zlatni-rat.sunbeds: Paid, EUR 10-15 per sunbed (2026), umbrella extra; EUR 13 each reported; set-back bed EUR 44
zlatni-rat.food: Restaurants and cafes in the area (menus not checked)
zlatni-rat.note: Beach access itself is free. Taxi stand in Bol centre; taxi boat from port about EUR 4.

sakarun-beach.access: Road to beach; tourist train from Bozava (4 km) in summer
sakarun-beach.parking: Paid in season: EUR 6 for 2 h (recent review), free off-season; some park on roadside
sakarun-beach.sunbeds: Loungers and umbrellas for rent (price not found)
sakarun-beach.food: Two catering facilities (beach bars, a burger place), serve in high season
sakarun-beach.toilets: One chemical toilet reported (for bar users)
sakarun-beach.note: No campsite at Sakarun itself; campsites near Veli Rat (separate beach).

stiniva.access: Steep 30-45 min hike, or by boat from Vis Town / Komiza; tour boats arrive 10:00-16:00
stiniva.parking: Conflicting: no dedicated parking vs. lot at top of hill
stiniva.food: Sources conflict: small bar at the bottom vs. no cafes or toilets. Bring water and food
stiniva.note: Go early; avoid midday tour boats. Not accessible for disabled visitors.

punta-rata.parking: Prices inconsistent: from EUR 4/h up to EUR 25/day (reviews)
punta-rata.sunbeds: Paid; reports EUR 28 for 2 loungers + parasol, or EUR 7 bed + EUR 5 umbrella (old)
punta-rata.food: Restaurants and cafes nearby; terrace Adriatik recommended by one visitor
punta-rata.note: Very crowded in August. Reviews dated; no official price list found.

banje-beach.access: Public beach by Dubrovnik Old Town (Ploce)

dubovica.access: Steep 10-15 min path; not accessible for mobility impairments
dubovica.parking: Free roadside verge, very limited; fills by 09:00 in Jul-Aug
dubovica.sunbeds: Sources conflict: none vs. EUR 15-20 per pair at the bar (one source)
dubovica.food: Konoba Dubovica (fried fish, shrimp) and Duba Beach Bar (cocktails; reportedly no beer/food, one review)
dubovica.note: About 8 km from Hvar Town. Bring shoes, shade, water.

saplunara.access: Road on Mljet, about 16 km from Sobra ferry port; taxi safer than bus
saplunara.parking: About EUR 5/day, limited in peak summer
saplunara.food: Beach bars June-Sept (Hippocampus, Al Panchetto, Mala Saplunara, Kod Ante named in one listing)
saplunara.toilets: Toilet and shower listed in one source
saplunara.note: One visitor complained of dirt and yachts. No direct ferry.

rajska-plaza.parking: Car park nearby, about 200 spaces (fee not found)
rajska-plaza.camper: Camping San Marino beside the beach: pitches from about EUR 40/night (EUR 40-90 range)
rajska-plaza.sunbeds: Loungers and parasols for rent (price not found)
rajska-plaza.food: Several beach bars: Sunset, Bamboocho, Trstika, Pocco Locco, Porto, Spot Bar

bacvice.food: Cafes and restaurants in the pavilion behind the beach; party area at night

sunj-beach.access: Ferry from Dubrovnik (Gruz) to Lopud harbour, then 20-45 min walk or EUR 3 golf-buggy
sunj-beach.sunbeds: Paid via bars: about EUR 10 per bed full day (reviews)
sunj-beach.food: Beach bars along the back of the beach (party spot); bring own water to save
sunj-beach.toilets: Public toilet at Beach Bar Sunj; open shower EUR 1
sunj-beach.note: Ferry fare about EUR 10 (old listing); check Jadrolinija.

palombaggia.parking: Free lot at NE end fills fast; paid lots reported EUR 4-15/day, one at EUR 35 (meter, to 14:30). Prices differ by lot
palombaggia.sunbeds: Rentable but limited; no reliable price. Palm Beach club sunbeds criticised as overpriced
palombaggia.food: Several beach restaurants (Palm Beach: seafood/Med); bring cash. Example: 2 coffees EUR 5, 2 ice creams EUR 10
palombaggia.note: Reviews only; no official tariff found.

saleccia.access: Taxi boat from Saint-Florent (about 20-45 min, EUR 25-30 return), 4x4 track 12 km from Casta (about 1 h + 10-15 min walk), or 4-5 h hike
saleccia.parking: Paid EUR 5-10 near the beach (sources differ)
saleccia.food: One snack bar / simple restaurant reported; bring picnic
saleccia.note: Boat + 4x4 package from about EUR 55. Camping U Paradisu nearby.

santa-giulia.food: Bars and restaurants along the shore (about 5 beach restaurants per one listing)

rondinara-beach.access: Road to the back of the bay
rondinara-beach.parking: About EUR 5-6/day (2020 / 2025 sources); may be free out of season
rondinara-beach.camper: Camping Rondinara next to the beach: about EUR 29/night without electricity; open about 15 May-30 Sep (2025); beach parking reportedly included for campers
rondinara-beach.food: Chez Ange restaurant near the parking; campsite has snack bar, pizzeria, restaurant
rondinara-beach.note: Narrow bendy road. Pay by card or cash unclear.

pampelonne-beach.access: Six access points along a 5 km beach
pampelonne-beach.parking: Paid, about EUR 4-5/day; hard in Jul-Aug; some clubs offer valet
pampelonne-beach.camper: Paid motorhome area behind the beach: EUR 22/night from 1 April 2026 (single night tickets), no electricity/toilets/showers; bridge limit 5.5 t
pampelonne-beach.sunbeds: Paid and varied: about EUR 30-60 per person per day, up to EUR 100; Shellona EUR 300-500+ (includes lunch). Free public sand sections
pampelonne-beach.food: Beach clubs: Club 55 (expensive), L'Esquinade (cheaper). Book ahead in Jul-Aug
pampelonne-beach.toilets: Public toilets and showers near access points
pampelonne-beach.note: Part of the beach is naturist.

en-vau-calanque.access: Hike from Cassis (7.8 km, 3 h, 360 m climb; final descent steep) or about 60-90 min from Port-Miou / D559 parking
en-vau-calanque.parking: Paid meter parking in Cassis; Col de la Gardiole lot no longer available; Port-Miou hard on weekends
en-vau-calanque.food: None; bring all water and food (1.5 L min.)
en-vau-calanque.note: Access rules change yearly with fire risk. Check Calanques National Park site / Mes Calanques app.

plage-notre-dame.access: Ferry from Tour Fondue (15 min) or La Londe (free parking at Port Miramar), then 3.5 km by bike (25 min) or walk (45 min)
plage-notre-dame.parking: No cars on Porquerolles; bike parking at beach
plage-notre-dame.sunbeds: Unconfirmed; one 2016 blog says no sunbeds/umbrellas on island beaches
plage-notre-dame.food: No restaurant at Notre-Dame; restaurant and sunbed hire at Plage d'Argent
plage-notre-dame.lifeguard: Only Plage d'Argent has a lifeguard
plage-notre-dame.note: Free access. Rent bikes ahead in high season.

calanque-de-sormiou.access: Road closed to cars for non-residents from first April weekend to All Saints, except restaurant customers; or walk about 1 h from Cayolle lot
calanque-de-sormiou.parking: Outer Cayolle lot about EUR 4.5-5, unsupervised; inner lot for restaurant customers (reserve at Le Chateau)
calanque-de-sormiou.food: Restaurant Le Chateau (reservation also gives parking access)
calanque-de-sormiou.note: Park limits visitors in peak: free online reservation (3 days ahead). Can close for fire risk.

blue-lagoon-comino.access: Ferry from Cirkewwa or Mgarr, or cruise; free Natura 2000 pass required to land (limited daily)
blue-lagoon-comino.sunbeds: Paid, about EUR 15-20 per set/person; limited by midday
blue-lagoon-comino.food: Food trucks; prices high (juice EUR 8, pizza/burger EUR 10)
blue-lagoon-comino.note: Ferry about EUR 10-15 return; cruises EUR 13-45. Go before 09:15 or after 17:00.

golden-bay.parking: Two lots: one free smaller lot reported, other about EUR 1/h; full by 09:00 in summer
golden-bay.sunbeds: Paid, about EUR 17 for 2 loungers + umbrella; lockers EUR 5
golden-bay.food: Several beach restaurants, snack bars; lunch about EUR 20

ghajn-tuffieha-bay.parking: Top lot: free but full after 09:30 (one source) or about EUR 1.50/h
ghajn-tuffieha-bay.sunbeds: For hire (Riviera Martinique Lido); price not found
ghajn-tuffieha-bay.food: Snack bar / kiosk at corner of bay (overpriced per one guide)

ramla-bay.parking: Free along the access road; private lot EUR 2/day
ramla-bay.sunbeds: Paid: about EUR 15 for 2 loungers + parasol (2021), EUR 5-7 per item
ramla-bay.food: Snack kiosks and two basic beach restaurants

ghadira-bay.parking: Free car parks along the beach; fill by 09:00 in summer
ghadira-bay.sunbeds: Paid, about EUR 12-20 per set (2 beds + umbrella)
ghadira-bay.food: About 9 restaurants and bars (Sol Beach Bar, Munchies, Maxima Lido, Ventuno, San Remo) plus kiosks
ghadira-bay.toilets: Toilet access often included with rental

st-peter-s-pool.access: Rocky inlet with ladders; walk from lot
st-peter-s-pool.parking: First lot about EUR 3 (cash), or free dirt lot further down; full by 09:00 in Jul-Aug
st-peter-s-pool.food: No bar; one cash snack van in summer (not reliable)

san-blas-bay.access: About 200 steps or rough track; do not drive down
san-blas-bay.parking: Small lot at top, very limited
san-blas-bay.sunbeds: Sources conflict: none vs. kiosk rentals
san-blas-bay.food: Small summer kiosk (drinks, snacks) per some sources
san-blas-bay.note: Summer jeep shuttle about EUR 2.50 pp; bus 303 then 600-650 m walk.

sveti-stefan.access: Public beach north of island; island itself private (entry EUR 25 pp per one guide, under 12 free). Queen's Beach reserved for Aman guests
sveti-stefan.parking: Paid, about EUR 2-4/hour (flat EUR 12 older); usually packed. Some free spots before entrance
sveti-stefan.sunbeds: Paid: EUR 30-60 per set; first row EUR 77, second EUR 66 (2024); south side about EUR 100/day. Free public section to lay a towel
sveti-stefan.food: Restaurants on island (table booking); cafes nearby

jaz-beach.parking: Large lot reported free with spaces even in the afternoon; campervans can park
jaz-beach.camper: Camping Jaz at the beach (rates not found; sanitary blocks reported in poor shape)
jaz-beach.sunbeds: Paid, about EUR 10 for 2 sunbeds + umbrella (reviews); some areas free
jaz-beach.food: Shops, restaurants and numerous bars near camp; supermarket on site
jaz-beach.note: Part of the beach is naturist. Concert venue in some summers.

valdanos-bay.access: 10 min drive from Ulcinj; narrow road through olive grove; taxi EUR 5-7
valdanos-bay.parking: Large free outdoor lot, partly shaded
valdanos-bay.sunbeds: Sunbeds for hire (price not found); room for own umbrella
valdanos-bay.food: Beach bar (pizza, drinks) and on-site restaurant
valdanos-bay.note: Pebbles: water shoes. Upkeep inconsistent (litter reported).

kamenovo.access: 5 min walk from Rafailovici; steep cliff path from parking
kamenovo.parking: Reports conflict: free vs paid EUR 3-5/day (card accepted)
kamenovo.sunbeds: Paid: EUR 15-25 per bed by row, EUR 20-30 per set; bring own umbrella and towel to use beach free
kamenovo.food: Two restaurants (one with beach service), bars; small beer EUR 2.90-4.60

ksamil-beaches.access: Several small beaches; some via unpaved roads
ksamil-beaches.parking: Pulebardha lot EUR 1; free lots elsewhere (Edon-Bina free, 10 min walk). Hard to find parking near popular bays by 10:00
ksamil-beaches.sunbeds: Paid: EUR 10-30 per 2 beds + umbrella, up to EUR 40+ peak; Beach 1 800-1,500 ALL, Beach 2 500-1,000, Beach 3 500-800. Fee often waived with food/drink
ksamil-beaches.food: Beach restaurants and bars at most rented sections
ksamil-beaches.note: Very few free spots in high season; Beach 3 has the most free sand.

gjipe.access: 30-45 min walk (2.5 km) from parking, or boat from Himara / water taxi EUR 15-20; jeep rides in summer 500-1,000 ALL; canyon route is hard
gjipe.parking: Paid: 200 lek pp or 300 lek/day (EUR 3), 1,000 lek overnight
gjipe.camper: Camping allowed; Gjipe Eco Campground (flush toilets, cold showers, restaurant, bar, SUP/canoe rental); day tickets sold for showers/toilets

maspalomas-dunes.note: Protected dune field meeting the Atlantic. Bring water and shade. Stay on marked routes. Parts of the beach are used by naturists.
